channel.title: eToro incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from eToro's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Outbound eToro Money Payments Temporarily Halted [resolved]
item.description:
The issue affecting outbound payments from eToro Money has now been resolved.
All outbound payments are now fully enabled, and clients can complete their transactions as expected.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience while our team worked to resolve the issue.
Thank you for your understanding.
Sincerely, The eToro Team

item.title: Temporary Issue with Credit Card Deposits [resolved]
item.description:
The issue affecting credit card deposits has now been resolved.
Customers can now enter their credit card details and complete deposits as expected.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience while our team worked to resolve the issue.
Thank you for your understanding.
Sincerely, The eToro Team

item.title: Temporary Issue with Deposits and Withdrawals [resolved]
item.description:
We've restored all affected services, and the customer impact has been mitigated.
Deposits, withdrawals, and the ability to open new positions are now functioning normally. Our team will continue to closely monitor the platform to ensure everything remains stable.
We sincerely apologize for the disruption and thank you for your patience and understanding throughout this incident.
Sincerely, The eToro Team

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and appreciate your patience while we worked to resolve the issue.
Sincerely, The eToro Team
